system.description: Your illusions can affect a person's mind directly: illusory shackles restrain, illusory wounds are believed real, and you may craft arrows that never miss or Rötschreck-inducing flames that cannot be doused. Works on only one victim at a time. Expend a Willpower Trait and win a Social Challenge; wounds remain until the victim is convinced they were illusory or heals himself psychologically. Vampires 'killed' enter torpor; mortals fall into a coma.
